title: Multiracial students account for 7.2% of Hastings High School population in 2025-26
text:
In the 2025-26 school year, Hastings High School enrolled 37 students who identified as multiracial, marking an increase of 5.7% from the prior year, the New York State Education Department reported.
The school’s total enrollment for 2025-26 was 516 students. Multiracial students represented 7.2% of the student population, making this group the third largest ethnic demographic at the school.
Located in the Hastings-On-Hudson Union Free School District, the high school is overseen from a central office in Hastings On Hudson.
Of the district’s three schools, Hillside Elementary School had the largest multiracial enrollment at that time with 69 students.
New York is ranked second in the U.S. for K-12 public education spending . Its per-student expenditure for current operations averaged $30,012—almost twice the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
